title: "jest/no-focused-tests"
description: "Disallow `test.only`, `describe.only`, `fit` and `fdescribe`"
# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

`.only` makes Jest run that test and skip every other one in the file. It's useful while debugging. If you commit one by accident, it hides failures in the tests that no longer run.

The `f` prefix does the same thing, so `fit` and `fdescribe` are reported too.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jest/no-focused-tests" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```ts
import { expect, fit, test } from "@jest/globals";

test.only("adds", () => {
  expect(1 + 1).toBe(2);
});

fit("subtracts", () => {
  expect(2 - 1).toBe(1);
});
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { expect, it, test } from "@jest/globals";

test("adds", () => {
  expect(1 + 1).toBe(2);
});

it("subtracts", () => {
  expect(2 - 1).toBe(1);
});
```
